Resource Interaction Proof Consensus

The Star Tower project uses a self-developed consensus mechanism called Resource Interaction Proof (RIP for short). Resource Interaction Proof is a new type of proof-of-work mechanism that aims to use resource sharing and block processing of user smart devices to achieve the mining process.

Ai Star Tower Self-Inspection

Ai Star Tower has automatic inspection and self-processing functions. Star Tower Ai, which we built into each module, uses machine learning and deep learning algorithms to process large amounts of transaction and block data to improve the efficiency and accuracy of verification. It can reduce the workload and computation of node audits, and can automatically fix vulnerabilities, improve transaction processing speed and overall system security.
